meta.name: description
meta.content: IXL is the world's most popular subscription-based learning site. Used by over 18 million students, IXL provides unlimited practice in more than 8,000 maths, English and science topics. Interactive questions, awards and certificates keep kids motivated as they master skills.
IXL | Maths, English and Science Practice

IXL is the world's most popular subscription-based learning site. Used by over 18 million students, IXL provides unlimited practice in more than 8,000 maths, English and science topics. Interactive questions, awards and certificates keep kids motivated as they master skills.
